rationale: Hold: nothing already planned changes. This extends the horizon by one week (23-29 Nov, provisional) and carries 9-15 and 16-22 Nov forward unchanged. Two clean easy runs (6.4 and 7.0 km, achilles 0, HRV/RHR flat) support the rebuild but are not yet a calf-clear week; that is the coming one. In 23-29 Nov volume holds at about 54 km while strides return, because volume and intensity should not rise in the same week. Tempo waits until 5 Dec at the earliest.
